name: Light Fades Twice Lizalfos + Chilfos + Darknut PRIVATE TEST

description: 0.13.14 DARKNUT MINIBOSS FIX05 (DKN01): the normal Darknut of Enemy Spawner only (B_TN 0x000001FF): phase 1 with 600 HP, posture 200 and progressive armour, phases 2/3 with 480 resistance and posture 160/180; every defended contact keeps Link's chain and the exchange until a real pause / empty swings, parry by ordinal 0/0/0/25/45/60, a persisting rebound gives Link +20/+25 and ONE counter, Lizalfos parry effects both ways as one transaction, F2/F3 four combos only (shield-held kick kept), counter double on the F2-C1 rhythm, the sword draw's remote sweep removed; LGC01: Link cancels an ordinary cut to his shield (R) before its hitbox or in its recovery, R+B Shield Attack from it; DKR01 resurrection and executions unchanged; every other enemy unchanged.
